name: ChapterHero - With Image
description: The full-bleed city header. The title used to read Harvard Alumni in Tech plus the city, which was strained for a place and actively wrong for a group - the AI community's banner announced HARVARD ALUMNI IN TECH AI, which reads as a product rather than people. The organisation's name moved into the small uppercase kicker above, leaving the city as the title. That split is also what gives a forming chapter somewhere honest to say so, since the kicker can read Chapter - Forming without touching the title.
